faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 08-09-2026. It is advised to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 48200 per month, along with an additional 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a postgraduate degree in Communication, Management, Humanities or a relevant field with 8 years of experience, or a graduate with 15 years of experience in a government organization or educational institute, or CA/ICWA/CS with 2 years of supervisory experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Manager post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Manager at IIT Kanpur is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is https://www.iitk.ac.in/. You can visit it for more information.
